title: 1988 Topps Baseball Card Kal Daniels Cincinnati Reds #622
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 1988 Topps baseball trading card featuring Kal Daniels of the Cincinnati Reds, card number 622. This red parallel variety card is an original United States manufacture and is part of the 1988 Topps set. It is a sports trading card sought after by collectors.
